# Eagle Maritime OS

> Intelligent vessel governance and international maritime compliance platform covering SOLAS, MARPOL, ISM, ISPS, MLC, STCW, CII, and EEXI.

Eagle Maritime OS helps fleet operators manage vessels, certificates, crew, audits, incidents, maintenance, and regulatory compliance from a single system.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Eagle Maritime OS landing and platform overview.
- [Certificate Verification](/verify): Public portal to verify the authenticity of a vessel certificate issued via Eagle Maritime OS.
